source_review.supports: Facility identity and published interior imagery; no dimensioned exterior elevations.
GIS horizontal footprint only; not survey control and not master-placement validation.

changes: Replaced the oversized entry plaque with direct-mounted warm-white building-name lettering at the Street View-supported entrance location. Its scale is a visual estimate; source imagery is not calibrated.
Reworked the qualitative street-approach camera to frame the brick/glazed entry and canopy in a three-quarter view. Camera placement is a presentation choice, not a survey coordinate.
Added restrained running-bond procedural brick relief/color variation and softened roof-metal finish. No external textures.
Added 43 standing seams on each estimated roof slope for roof-surface articulation; the shallow-gable roof profile remains uncertain and the seams are not source-measured.

Updated the interior gallery cutaway presentation so mezzanine, representative seating, stairs, diving tower and pool circulation read without roof trusses crossing the view. Interior plan remains schematic.
validation: validation_r3.json: reopened saved file in Blender 5.2.3; all checks passed. The full transformed official FID 896 footprint is bidirectionally compared with all 70 shell perimeter segments; maximum sampled mismatch 0.000002 m each direction. This shows GIS boundary correspondence only, not survey accuracy or master placement. Checks also confirm 57 ribbon panes, 300 representative seat blocks, mezzanine/stairs, published 5.1816 m dive depth and five platform elevations, all meshes have materials and no external image dependencies.
uncertainties: No calibrated exterior elevation or roof section was located; roof profile, eave/ridge dimensions and exact facade bay dimensions remain estimates.
No as-built interior plan was located; seat count shown is representative (300 of published 625), and gallery supports/circulation are schematic.
GIS does not establish vertical dimensions or master-scene placement.
